title: KGB Kiteboarding & Watersports
specs: Jet ski assisted coaching at various Bay Area locations including Toll Plaza Beach, Treasure Island, Alcatraz, Golden Gate Bridge, Sherman Island
Prerequisite for Water Session: basic kite control on land (Ground School)
No prerequisite for Introduction to Kiteboarding
Closed-toe shoes and sweater for Ground School and The Taster
Wetsuit and water shoes or boots required for Water Session
Sessions typically one-on-one; Ground School semi-private with up to 2 participants; The Taster semi-private with 2 to 3 participants
includes: Use of wetsuit and harness if you do not have your own (limited availability)
blurb: Guests learn kiteboarding through ground school and water sessions, progressing from basic kite control on land to riding in the water. Sessions include one-on-one coaching with jet ski assistance at various Bay Area locations. Equipment like wetsuits and harnesses are required and can be provided if needed.
